description: Source code for HTML deserialization and parsing functions used in a document editor, including handling of HTML elements, attributes, and conversion to internal node representations.

methods.name: getAlignmentFromElement
methods.description: Determines text alignment ('center' or 'end') from HTML element attributes or styles.

methods.name: marksFromElementAttributes
methods.description: Extracts formatting marks (bold, italic, underline, etc.) from HTML element attributes and styles.

methods.name: deserializeHTML
methods.description: Parses HTML string into internal node representation, fixing nodes for block children.

methods.name: deserializeHTMLNode
methods.description: Converts a single HTML node into internal deserialized nodes, handling various HTML tags and attributes.

methods.name: deserializeNodes
methods.description: Processes multiple DOM nodes into internal node structures.

methods.name: fixNodesForBlockChildren
methods.description: Ensures proper structure of deserialized nodes, wrapping inline nodes in paragraphs if needed.
